host: the platform on CellB in Node (packages/platform, dist/platform/cellb)

steps.title: Write the project's files
steps.note: The working tree replaces whatever the project held. A ZIP works too; single files go with PUT /p/tasks/files/<path>.
steps.curl:
node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const files={};for(const p of process.argv.slice(1))files[p]=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");console.log(JSON.stringify({files}))' index.html package.json src/* \
  | curl -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- http://localhost:8787/p/tasks/import

steps.title: Take a snapshot
steps.note: The snapshot id is the hash of the tree. Everything under its base URL is immutable.

steps.title: A TSX file, served as ESM
steps.note: Types are stripped and JSX compiled with the automatic runtime. Every import is now a URL: the project's own files stay under the snapshot, npm packages go to the CDN's pinned URLs (through the snapshot's ~deps proxy) at the ranges in package.json.

steps.title: CSS, as a module
steps.note: Nested CSS is lowered by Lightning CSS for the browsers it targets.

steps.title: Resolve the entry points
steps.note: The URL of each entry and the project modules to preload.

steps.title: Snapshot again: a new id
steps.note: Only the changed file is transformed again when it is requested; the old snapshot still serves the old file, so an open page never mixes versions.
